local function createButton(name, text, position, callback)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Name = name
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
    Button.Position = position
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 30, 0)
    Button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 65)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 2
    Button.Text = text
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 65)
    Button.TextScaled = true
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    Button.Parent = MainFrame
    
    local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    ButtonCorner.Parent = Button
    
    -- Efeito hover
    Button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 50, 0)
    end)
    
    Button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 30, 0)
    end)
    
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    
    return Button
end

local function playScaryMusic()
    spawn(function()
        updateStatus("ðŸŽµ Tocando mÃºsica assombrada...")
        
        -- Parar mÃºsica atual se existir
        if currentSound then
            currentSound:Stop()
            currentSound:Destroy()
        end
        
        -- Criar novo som
        currentSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        currentSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://7795812961"
        currentSound.Volume = 1 -- Volume mÃ¡ximo
        currentSound.Looped = false
        currentSound.Parent = Workspace
        
        -- Tocar a mÃºsica
        currentSound:Play()
        
        -- Detectar quando a mÃºsica termina
        currentSound.Ended:Connect(function()
            updateStatus("ðŸŽµ MÃºsica terminou!")
            if currentSound then
                currentSound:Destroy()
                currentSound = nil
            end
        end)
        
        updateStatus("ðŸŽµ MÃºsica tocando no volume mÃ¡ximo!")
    end)
end

local function bigHeads()
    spawn(function()
        updateStatus("ðŸ‘¤ Aplicando cabeÃ§as gigantes...")
        
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                local head = player.Character.Head
                
                -- Fazer cabeÃ§a gigante
                head.Size = Vector3.new(15, 15, 15)
                head.CanCollide = true
                head.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
                
                -- Ajustar mesh se existir

                if mesh then

                -- Adicionar efeitos visuais

                Fire.Heat = 15

                PointLight.Brightness = 5

-- FUNÃ‡ÃƒO EXTRA: RESET
local function resetAll()
    spawn(function()
        updateStatus("ðŸ”„ Resetando tudo...")
        
        -- Parar mÃºsica se estiver tocando
        if currentSound then
            currentSound:Stop()
            currentSound:Destroy()
            currentSound = nil
        end
        
        -- Remover efeitos
        for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("PointLight") then
                obj:Destroy()
            elseif obj:IsA("Decal") then
                obj:Destroy()
            elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
        
        -- Reset lighting

        Lighting.Brightness = 1

        Lighting.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
